catalogueNote: The account served 11 models that day. Removing audio (whisper, orpheus), classifiers (llama-prompt-guard) and the barred gpt-oss family leaves exactly two usable chat models, and both are here. The matrix is two families because the account has two, not because two were picked.

staleness: If Groq retires a model listed here, replay still works from the committed recordings; only a fresh --live run would fail, and it would fail loudly on a 404 rather than silently substituting another model.

models.note: The model of record, re-sampled into its own fixture file. Its own committed recordings are never touched, so the difference between this row and the headline numbers measures run-to-run variance rather than a change of model.
